decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans and information submitted (S1 of S3 received 09.08.11, S2 of S3 and S3 of S3 received 09.03.12.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The kitchen extract system shall be provided, before the use is brought into operation, and when at maximum operation shall not result in noise that is more than 10dB(A) below background noise levels for the site. The kitchen extract system shall include the following details:
a) A three-stage filtration system, including grease filters, pre-carbon filters and carbon filters, to be located inside the building.
b) The point of discharge shall be a minimum of one metre above eaves level or one metre above openable windows of nearby properties.
c) The ducting shall be circular.
d) The ventilation duct shall terminate pointing directly upwards and shall not be fitted with a cowl.
e) The fan shall be isolated from the inlet and discharge ducts using flexible couplings.
f) The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts.
g) The duct shall be isolated from the structure of the building using anti-vibration mouldings and suitable packing material where it passes through solid structures.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 8am -11pm, Monday to Saturday and 9am - 11pm on Sundays and Bank Holidays.
Condition : 5 - All roller shutters shall be contained internally behind the glazing on the unit frontage.
Condition : 6 - The use hereby approved shall not commence until level access and a door width of no less than 900mm clear opening have been provided to both the front and rear elevations.
description: Change of use from A1 (retail) to A5 (takeaway).
